titulo_es: A result · Narrar made in order

texto: A narrative organizes the facts with «først», «bagefter» and «til sidst». Check what happened before and what changed after; the order of the sentences does not always match the temporary order.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.es: Por eso llegaron a tiempo a la reunión.
frases.en: That's why they arrived in time for the meeting.
